run_notes: PO variance accepted (policy 4): INV-000491 corrected (R08), net 315.50 against PO-1044 net 300.00, +15.50 net, within the 50.00 tolerance. Pay the invoice gross GBP 378.60. Reason: the invoice lines, business cards 150.00 plus letterheads 165.50 (2,000 sheets at 82.75 per thousand), come to 315.50 and the PO gives one net figure of 300.00. The supplier's correction raised the letterhead line by 5.00 net; the superseded version was +10.50 net against the PO.
No other PO variance: INV-000482 net 1,240.00 equals PO-1041; MD-2026-057 net 4,500.00 equals PO-1039; Kestrel 7731 net USD 960.00 equals PO-1046 (recorded in USD).
Already paid (policy 6): INV-000482, GBP 1,488.00, paid 2026-09-18 per the bank feed. The extractor's extraction-level pay for R01 is overturned by the bank check.

Credit note (policy 7): CN-012 GBP 300.00 was refunded, bank feed CR GBP 300.00 on 2026-09-10, ref MARLOW DESIGN CN-012 REFUND. Nothing is offset against MD-2026-057. The supplier gave 9 Sep as the refund date and the bank shows 10 Sep; amount and reference match.
Duplicates and versions (policy 5): MD-2026-057 is paid once (R06; R09 is a resend). INV-000491 is paid once at the corrected amount (R08; R07 is superseded).
Approval (policy 3): MD-2026-057 GBP 5,400.00 gross is the only payment above GBP 2,000.00. The principal approved it (Q1 APPROVE, mail #11); pay GBP 5,400.00 in this run.

Kestrel Cloud 7731 is held out of this run on the principal's decision (Q2 HOLD, mail #12). It goes in the FX run on 2026-10-07, ahead of its 2026-10-12 due date, and stays on this run as HOLD with amount_to_pay 0.00 (USD 960.00 to be paid then, to the USD account on file). Cause: USD invoice in a GBP-only run and the policy is silent (policy 10).

Northfield bank-detail request (R11): rejected by the principal (Q3 REJECT, mail #13) and treated as suspected fraud; the principal will call Northfield on the number on file. Not acted on, not answered, supplier master not edited (policies 8 and 9). All Northfield payments go to the details on file.

Evergreen Office Supplies: no invoice this month. The statement shows a zero balance, consistent with the bank feed (DR GBP 142.80 on 2026-09-03, ref EO-55120). PO-1047 (GBP 180.00 net, raised 2026-09-22) has no invoice yet; nothing to pay.
